world.name: The Fractured Outskirts
world.blurb: The Fractured Outskirts: one continuous road with 14 checkpointed challenges, ending in a superroom.
world.outro: Three bells answer across the empty Muster. The Sentinel lowers its hammer. The woods remember the way ahead.

keepsake.name: Mara, remembered
keepsake.gives: She kept drawing a road for someone who might return. Shown at the end.

keepsake.name: Rowan, remembered
keepsake.gives: He rang the bell until someone answered. Shown at the end.

rooms.name: The Ash Verge
rooms.hint: Dash along the ground, then jump before the dash ends: the jump keeps the dash’s speed (a super)
rooms.question: The gap is wider than a jump and a dash together. What if the dash comes first, on the ground?

rooms.name: The Hollow Mile
rooms.hint: Cracked stone gives you a breath, not a rest · land, turn, and super again
rooms.question: Two gaps, each a super long. Where does the second one start?

rooms.name: Watcher’s Ridge
rooms.hint: A super spends the dash on the ground · the crystal at the end of its arc gives it back
rooms.question: The first crystal is past any plain jump. What carries you to it with nothing left to spend?

rooms.name: The Survey Stone
rooms.hint: The cracked road starts shaking as you step on it · Mara’s chart opens the lost survey behind you
rooms.question: The road under your runway is cracked. How long do you have to start the super?

people.name: MARA’S ECHO
people.line: Your chart still has a road here. Mine stopped.
people.lineDone: There it is. A way through the blank.

rooms.name: The Burnt Lookout
rooms.hint: Thorns grow on alternate walls · the top of the chimney is a runway, just
rooms.question: Up the chimney, and off the top with a super. Which wall does each stretch belong to?

rooms.name: The Cracked Road
rooms.hint: Every island cracks · the long gap wants a super, the short ones only a jump
rooms.question: Nothing here holds for long. Which island do you super from?

rooms.name: Camp Echo, Empty
rooms.hint: Dash into the tear · Rowan’s bell opens the way back through the camp
rooms.question: The tear lifts you to a cracked ledge. What do you do before it falls?

people.name: ROWAN’S ECHO
people.line: The bell is behind you. It always was.
people.lineDone: Someone answered. I can leave it ringing.

rooms.name: The Gatehouse
rooms.hint: Every survey stake lit opens the gate · the last one hangs in the arc of a super
rooms.question: Two stakes, and only one of them is anywhere you could stand near. How do you pass the other?

rooms.name: Muster Yard
rooms.hint: Everything the road has taught, in one breath
rooms.question: A tear, a cracked perch, a super, a crystal. In what order, and with what right in hand?

rooms.name: The Centre Bell
rooms.hint: The committed hammer becomes a foothold · from its top, a super reaches the bell
rooms.question: The bell’s ledge is past any plain jump. Where can you stand to start a super that reaches it?

rooms.name: The East Bell
rooms.hint: Its rush ends under you · its shoulders rise into a step
rooms.question: The rush passes under your ledge. From its shoulders, how far can a super go?

rooms.name: The Unfinished Chart
rooms.hint: A super, a tear, a super back: the blank has no floor
rooms.question: Two supers in opposite directions, and only cracked stone between. Where does each start?

people.name: MARA’S ECHO
people.line: I drew the way out. Keep the part that still leads somewhere.
people.lineDone: The blank has an edge now.

rooms.name: The Camp That Answered
rooms.hint: Thorns up the pillar · one crystal · the lip is cracked · so is the stone halfway to the bell
rooms.question: Up the pillar on one crystal, off a cracked lip with a super, and once more off a cracked stone. Where does the dash come back?

people.name: ROWAN’S ECHO
people.line: I heard it. That was enough.

rooms.name: Both at the End
rooms.hint: Light the stone, climb, then super up and hyper under — miss either and you start again
rooms.question: A raised ledge, then a low roof: which move lands high, and which one runs low?

rooms.name: Pass Below the Passing Thorn
rooms.hint: Hold Grab; Down ducks under the thorn. Reel Up over the stone, then jump free.
rooms.question: How do you move below a passing thorn without leaving the moving ring?

rooms.name: Leave the Light Behind
rooms.hint: A cut turns the mirror · Your carriage also shades the receiver.
rooms.question: When must your cover stop being cover?

rooms.name: Ring It from the Other Side
rooms.hint: The low bell recalls the hammer higher. Return below the crossing; its new head reaches the top.
rooms.question: Which part of the arena stays behind when the Sentinel answers the first bell?

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Torn Mile
retiredRoomDetails.evidence: Three tears deliver to cracked perches before a last super; the next Muster Yard adds a crystal to the same tear/perch/super chain. A new room can replace this intermediate chain while retaining the first tear lesson in Camp Echo.

retiredRoomDetails.name: The West Bell
retiredRoomDetails.reason: Replaced by its native boss superroom
